periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Convergent diagonal orientation where the superior poles are positioned further apart than the inferior poles.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Ovoid morphology with a high vertical-to-horizontal ratio, distinctly oval rather than circular.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Visible downward tapering effect at the base of the patches extending toward the muzzle.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Thick dark band visible at the shoulder junction, though the full torso ratio is partially obscured by posture.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Ears are positioned at the extreme superolateral margins of the cranium with a wide central gap.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, semicircular convex curvature at the top of both pinnae.

other_distinctive_markers: Physical occlusion of the lower facial and thoracic regions by multiple bamboo stalks.
